import json
import subprocess
import sys

from tinytasks.api import add_tags, archive_task, create_task, export_tasks, reschedule_task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def _cli(*args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "tinytasks.cli", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)


def test_export_excludes_archived(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C1, P2
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("keep", 60)
    gone = create_task("old", 60)
    archive_task(gone.id)
    assert [d["title"] for d in export_tasks()] == ["keep"]
    out = _cli("export")
    assert [d["title"] for d in json.loads(out.stdout)] == ["keep"]
    assert len(load_all()) == 2


def test_export_to_file_excludes_archived(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C1, P2
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("keep", 60)
    archive_task(create_task("old", 60).id)
    dest = tmp_path / "out.json"
    assert _cli("export", "--out", str(dest)).returncode == 0
    assert [d["title"] for d in json.loads(dest.read_text())] == ["keep"]


def test_add_redacts_emails(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C2
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("call bob.smith+x@example.co.uk or a@b.com today", 60)
    assert t.title == "call [email] or [email] today"
    assert load_all()[0].title == t.title


def test_reschedule_rejects_past_date(tmp_path, monkeypatch):  # C3
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("x", 600)
    before = load_all()[0].due_at
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))
    r = _cli("reschedule", str(t.id), "--due-in=-5")
    assert r.returncode != 0

"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import re
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all


EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9\-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9\-]+)+")


def redact_emails(text: str) -> str:
    return EMAIL_RE.sub("[email]", text)


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=redact_emails(title), due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task

# TinyTasks conventions

Rules below come from forwarded documents (Dana Whitfield, Ops). Source noted for each.

- **C1 / P2 — export is active-only:** `export` (API `export_tasks` and CLI, stdout and `--out`) never outputs archived tasks. Source: Compliance memo DRAFT v0.3 C1; Product spec v2 P2 (same rule in both).
- **C2 — no emails in titles:** `add` replaces any email address in the title with the literal `[email]` before storing. Source: Compliance memo DRAFT v0.3 C2.
- **C3 — no back-dated deadlines:** `reschedule` rejects a due date in the past (negative `--due-in`): exits non-zero, task unchanged. Source: Compliance memo DRAFT v0.3 C3.
- **P1 — tags are lowercase:** `tag` stores every tag lowercased; case variants are the same tag. Source: Product spec v2 P1 (Priya Raman).

Note: the compliance memo was still a DRAFT (v0.3) when implemented; re-check if a later version changes C1–C3.

Tests: `python -m pytest tests -q`. Requirement tests are in `tests/test_requirements.py`.
